verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents a built-in 'Intuit Intelligence' chat assistant that users can directly instruct to create invoices, resolve anomalies, run payroll, generate reports, and estimate tax savings, plus a Payroll AI that proactively handles payroll tasks — this is genuine task delegation to an embedded AI agent, not just automation rules. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming real-world reliability of these AI delegation features (community evidence discusses only rule-based categorization, not Intuit Intelligence specifically), and detail on the scope/limits of tasks it can autonomously complete.
